lines: In exchange for wings to fly the sky, we chose to hold hands, joined together
And still, bewitched by the sky, is it a sin to layer our dreams upon it?
Summer watches autumn's back and pictures its face
Is it longing, or is it love? Even knowing it can never come true
Gravity falls asleep — a once-in-a-thousand-years today
Standing in the sun's blind spot, let's leave this planet
When he opens his eyes, we'll be somewhere he can't drag us back from
On a count of three we kick off the earth, toward a star that isn't this one
Let's go — just a little further, beyond fate, just a little further, beyond civilization
Let's go — just a little further, beyond fate, just a little further
We hoist our sail on a dream, crossing the night for the day that's coming
Come now — with nothing but hope at full tank, saying we'll figure out the rest, we put our arms around each other's shoulders
Of course we're scared — but we can't stop
Even if we try to get ahead of every crisis, that's just not who we are
Our love speaks, a voice speaks
